gen-gf-dongle-fs-literata: Dongle draws a thread of ink, rounded like wire and squeezed tight. Literata follows in a serif with modest thick-thin contrast, like lightly engraved brass, so a bigger Dongle heading over a slightly smaller body feels natural.
gen-gf-doppio-one-fs-literata: Modern and plain, Doppio One keeps the heading simple, while Literata brings a text serif with a gentle thick-thin rhythm. Pages feel bookish.
gen-gf-dorsa-fs-literata: Dorsa packs its letters as tightly as a wound spring, yet the openings stay connected to the space outside. Literata then settles in as a text serif, sturdy in its hairlines and easy to keep reading.
gen-gf-dosis-fs-literata: Cramped but friendly, Dosis has no weight shift along its curves and terminals that stay open. And Literata, a text serif with hairlines neither wispy nor heavy, makes a sturdy body at a modest size under it.
gen-gf-dotgothic16-fs-literata: Neutral and contemporary, DotGothic16 draws hollow glass-tube letters with the constant line of a technical pen. Literata is a text serif that adds modest weight changes in its round letters, giving the two a pleasing tension.
gen-gf-doto-fs-literata: Scattered and modern, Doto leaves its letters at a distance, with terminals that stop short of curling back. And Literata, a text serif with restrained thick and thin in every glyph, gives the page a steady, bookish footing.
gen-gf-dynapuff-bitter: Chunky and bold, DynaPuff gives each letter its own space and a pen-like line. And Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye, reads dependable and grounded over long paragraphs.
gen-gf-dynapuff-instrument-sans: Distinctive from the first word, DynaPuff leaves every letter alone with space around it. And Instrument Sans, a sans with pincer-like c shapes and unvarying strokes, gives the strongest quality here: a clear gap between loud and quiet.
gen-gf-dynapuff-inter: Round and loud, DynaPuff sets big lowercase against small capitals with a pen-like line. And Inter, a sans with a smooth tube-like look and breathing counters, carries a longer read without any fuss.
gen-gf-dynapuff-mulish: A rounded-nib line of constant weight, with space around each letter, is what makes DynaPuff stand out. Mulish, the sans-serif, is built for plain reading.
